title.narrative: Strengthening Basic Sciences Education in the English- and Dutch-speaking Caribb

description.narrative: In the English- and Dutch-speaking Caribbean, there is a growing need to strengthen capacities and cooperation in basic sciences education. This need is reflected in the UNESCO Science Report 2021, which highlights persistent gaps in science education, practical experimentation, and STEM capacities in Small Island Developing States (SIDS). This initiative aims to strengthen capacities in micro-science and promote hands-on scientific experimentation within education systems across the Caribbean. Particular emphasis will be placed on encouraging the participation of women and youth in science education and STEM-related fields.
